Container.Name: plex-releases-summary
Container.Overview: A lightweight container that fetches recently added media from your Plex server via Tautulli and sends summaries to Discord. Minimal configuration required - just 2 fields (Tautulli URL and API key). Smart defaults: checks last 7 days, runs weekly on Sundays at 4 PM. Supports scheduled (daemon) or one-shot mode. Discord notifications optional. For complete documentation, see https://github.com/thomas-lg/plex-releases-summary/blob/main/README.md - For configuration guide, see https://github.com/thomas-lg/plex-releases-summary/blob/main/CONFIGURATION.md
Container.Requires: Minimal setup: Tautulli v2.1.0+ running and accessible with API enabled. On first run, config.yml is auto-created from template with environment variable references. Just set the required variables below (Tautulli URL and API key). For advanced configuration options and troubleshooting, see https://github.com/thomas-lg/plex-releases-summary/blob/main/CONFIGURATION.md

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Host path for config files. Container target is fixed to /app/configs (do not change). On first run, config.yml is auto-created.

Config.Name: AppData Logs Path
Config.Description: Host path for persistent logs. Container target is fixed to /app/logs (do not change).

Config.Name: Tautulli URL
Config.Description: Tautulli server URL (required). Example: http://tautulli:8181 or http://192.168.1.100:8181

Config.Name: Tautulli API Key
Config.Description: Tautulli API key (required). Find in Tautulli: Settings → Web Interface → API. Can be direct value or file path (e.g., /run/secrets/tautulli_api_key).

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional: Discord webhook URL or file path. Leave empty to disable notifications (default).

Config.Name: Run Once
Config.Description: Optional: One-shot mode ('true') or scheduled daemon ('false', default).

Config.Name: CRON Schedule
Config.Description: Optional: CRON schedule (default: '0 16 * * SUN' = Sunday 4 PM). Runs in container timezone (set TZ variable to change from UTC). Use crontab.guru for help.

Config.Name: Days Back
Config.Description: Optional: Days to look back for releases (default: 7).

Config.Name: Initial Batch Size
Config.Description: Optional: Override adaptive batch size for Tautulli API (1-10000). Leave empty for automatic sizing based on days_back.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional: Plex server URL for generating media links (default: https://app.plex.tv).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Optional: Timezone for CRON schedule (default: UTC). Examples: America/New_York, Europe/Paris, Asia/Tokyo. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Optional: Logging level - DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR (default: INFO).

Config.Name: Media Source
Config.Description: Optional: where recently added media is read from - tautulli (default) or tracearr.

Config.Name: Tracearr URL
Config.Description: Required when Media Source is tracearr: full URL to your Tracearr instance, e.g. http://tracearr:3000.

Config.Name: Tracearr API Key
Config.Description: Required when Media Source is tracearr: a trr_pub_ token created in Tracearr. Can point at a secret file, e.g. /run/secrets/tracearr_api_key. Note: Tracearr cannot report the Plex machine identifier, so set Plex Server ID for clickable links.

Config.Name: Excluded Media Types
Config.Description: Optional: Comma-separated media types to omit from the summary - movie, show, season, episode, album, track. Example: track,album to skip the music library. Leave empty to include everything.

Config.Name: Enable Health Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional: Serve GET /health for container liveness probes (default: false). Scheduled mode only. Set to true if you want an external monitor such as Uptime Kuma to poll it.

Config.Name: Health Endpoint Bind Address
Config.Description: Optional: Interface the health endpoint binds to (default: 127.0.0.1, reachable only inside the container). Set to 0.0.0.0 to let an external monitor reach it - the endpoint is unauthenticated.

Config.Name: Health Endpoint Port
Config.Description: Optional: Port for the health endpoint (default: 8080).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions. Set this to match your host user's UID to ensure proper access to mounted volumes (default: 99 for Unraid 'nobody' user).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions. Set this to match your host group's GID to ensure proper access to mounted volumes (default: 100 for Unraid 'users' group).
